notes: THE RESULT OF A FULL AUDIT. APPROVAL CAN NO LONGER BE SIDE-STEPPED - a payment the app raises itself is exempt only with the evidence behind it, and once a payment is approved, who it pays is fixed. SALARIES, staff bank details, TINs and SSNIT numbers are for finance staff only. CHANGING YOUR PASSWORD or making a recovery code asks for your current password. The installed app WILL NOT START IN DEBUGGING MODE. BILLS CAN NAME THE PURCHASE ORDER they pay, releasing the budget the order held. SETTLING A REVALUED foreign-currency invoice or bill counts the exchange gain once. A MONTH'S VAT REMITTANCE pays that month only. AGED DEBTORS AND CREDITORS drop reversed documents, the DONOR STATEMENT opens with the balance brought forward, and the PAYE RETURN prints the pay each payslip was calculated on. Capital allowances use original cost. Installing: no change to any figure already posted. Please take a backup first: Backup and Export, Back up now. Full notes are on the download page.
